// REQ: LANG-001 LANG-002 LANG-003 LANG-008 LANG-009 API-001 OUT-002 OUT-003
// Package demo shows the basics.
package demo

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

/* A block comment
   over two lines. */
type Point struct {
	X, Y int
	Name string
}

func (p *Point) Scale(k float64) error {
	if p == nil || k < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("bad scale %v", k)
	}
	p.X = int(float64(p.X) * k)
	p.Y *= 2
	return nil
}

func Equal[T comparable](a, b T) bool { return a == b }

func main() {
	pts := make([]Point, 0, 4)
	pts = append(pts, Point{X: 1, Y: 2})
	for i, p := range pts {
		go func() { defer recover(); _ = p.Scale(1.5) }()
		fmt.Println(i, len(pts), strings.ToUpper (p.Name))
	}
	var ch chan<- struct{}
	select {
	case ch <- struct{}{}:
	default:
	}
	switch x := any(true); x.(type) {
	case bool:
		fallthrough
	default:
		break
	}
	const c = iota
	goto end
end:
	var m map[string]interface{}
	_, _ = m, c
	clear(m)
	println(min(1, 2), max(3, 4), cap(pts), new(uintptr), real(complex(1, 2)), imag(2i))
	copy(pts, pts)
	delete(m, "k")
	close(make(chan error))
	if false || true {
		panic(nil)
	}
	type T = rune
	var _ = T(0) &^ 3
	var _ byte = ^uint8(1) % 7
	print(^0 | 1<<2 >> 1)
	continue
}
